literal: Those who possess wisdom possess everything; those who lack wisdom, what even if they possess, they have nothing.
translation: Those who possess wisdom possess everything; those who lack wisdom, whatever else they may possess, possess nothing at all.
modern: அறிவு உடையவர்கள் எல்லாவற்றையும் உடையவர்கள் ஆவர்; அறிவு இல்லாதவர்கள் வேறு எதனைப் பெற்று இருந்தாலும் ஒன்றும் இல்லாதவர்களே ஆவர்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the supreme value of wisdom over all material possessions. Those who have wisdom are considered to have everything, as wisdom guides them to acquire, protect, and use all other things rightly. Conversely, those who lack wisdom, even if they possess immense wealth or other resources, are deemed to have nothing because they cannot retain or use them properly. The contrast between 'உடையார்' (possessors) and 'இலர்' (those who have nothing) emphasizes that wisdom is the ultimate wealth.
